segments.sn35.143:1.2: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo rūpānaṃ uppādāya, sopi anicco.
segments.sn35.143:1.3: Aniccasambhūtā, bhikkhave, rūpā kuto niccā bhavissanti!
segments.sn35.143:1.4: Saddā … gandhā … rasā … phoṭṭhabbā … dhammā aniccā.
segments.sn35.143:1.9: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo dhammānaṃ uppādāya, sopi anicco.
segments.sn35.143:1.10: Aniccasambhūtā, bhikkhave, dhammā kuto niccā bhavissanti!
segments.sn35.143:1.11: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe …‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
